title: Pedals and Mirrors
style: Phonk chant with bouncy half-time drums, clipped handclaps, and a warped bass pulse; verse rides sparse percussion and vocal callouts, pre-chorus stacks rising gang chants, chorus hits with shouted unison hooks and short echo tails. Lead vocal is close-mic and gritty with doubled ad-libs, quick delay throws on names, reversed swells into transitions, and a dry, punchy mix with a hazy low-end glow.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Chant D d d DjZynRose
DJ Zyn Rose
Pedals everywhere
3. 3. 6.

Corey A I aye i eye
Zyn Thee-o
Zynthio!

Raffa Raps it back
Spining every track
Greybis with the band
we got that nica sound

[Chorus]
Mishy mish mash
Sings
With pickle ball delivery
Corey paddles it back
(Back)
Corey paddles it back

Reversing all the way
Mirrors guide the way
(Mirrors guide the way)
Reversing all the way
Mirrors guide the way

[Verse 2]
Sneaky phonk panterha
sneaky sound processor
Corey A I keeps it sweet.
Decoded mid road
Song Pal style!
